projects.name: DAGmate
projects.shows: Match escrow is a covenant with a trustless timeout forfeit — proven on testnet-10, then mainnet. The chain enforces the win.

projects.name: Dagger
projects.shows: Trades KCC-20 tokens across the L1 venues from a Telegram bot — every trade verifiable on kascov.

projects.name: Koracle
projects.shows: A named oracle signing facts with BIP340 and settling them into covenants and hashlocks — with its own four-tier honesty labels.
projects.note: listed on its public claims — no code or on-chain check yet

projects.name: Warda Protocol
projects.shows: An agent's budget compiled into the coin's script: a spend outside the cap is not refused — it is not a transaction.
projects.note: testnet-10, unaudited by its own statement

projects.name: Kaspire wallet
projects.shows: KCC-20 discovery and operations built on the Silverscript template — mainnet and testnet-10.

projects.name: DagSphere
projects.shows: Live holder maps for every KCC-20 token — bubbles by share of supply, funding-cluster detection, deployer tags. Read-only by design.

checks.what: read-only chain data; free access code via the Dagger bot

projects.name: KasProof
projects.tagline: Stamp any file onto the DAG
projects.shows: Your file is hashed in the browser, the hash becomes a Kaspa address, one transaction becomes a permanent timestamp anyone can verify — the file itself never leaves your device.

projects.name: Kassword
projects.tagline: A post-quantum vault on the DAG
projects.shows: Passwords, IDs and files encrypted in your browser with NIST post-quantum ciphers, then backed up as sealed noise onto the Kaspa BlockDAG — no accounts, no Kassword servers.

projects.name: KasRanks
projects.shows: An NFT collection where your rank is assigned by how much KAS your wallet holds — 782 handcrafted sea creatures across 11 tiers, from Plankton to Aquaman, native on the DAG.

projects.name: Enclave
projects.shows: A wallet built around understanding what you sign: SureSign spells out a transaction's effects before you approve, Deal Desk holds agreements in encrypted escrow rooms, and vaults carry defined access and inheritance terms.
projects.note: in active development · source not yet public

venues.name: KRON
venues.shows: Swap KCC-20 tokens against a permanently-locked AMM, or launch your own on a rug-proof bonding curve — live charts per token.

venues.name: KaspaRocket
venues.shows: Tokens climb a dual-phase bonding curve, then graduate to a constant-product AMM — and the venue publishes its Silverscript contracts.
venues.note: L1 trading proven end-to-end on testnet-10

venues.name: Zealous Swap
venues.shows: Protocol-owned liquidity, an insurance fund and NFT-based fees — a DEX with launchpad built for the long game.

checks.what: buy, sell and launch on testnet-10

venues.name: KForge
venues.tagline: Forge a token, watch it graduate
venues.shows: A launchpad and DEX built entirely from Kaspa covenants — the script holding the funds enforces the price.

venues.name: KaspaKaha
venues.shows: Pool-based AMM swaps where the covenant itself is the market maker — build a trade, sign it, the pool enforces the price.

venues.name: KaspaCom
venues.shows: Tokens, NFTs, domains and a KCC20 covenant marketplace — plus its own covenant explorer at covenants.kaspa.com.

checks.what: KCC20 marketplace live on mainnet, observed

explorers.name: kascov.io
explorers.shows: Browse live covenants, KCC-20 holdings and trades — and try covenant code right in the browser, nothing to install.
explorers.note: now also a daily data source for this site (templates feed)

explorers.name: KaspaCom Covenant Explorer
explorers.shows: KCC20 listings, trades, transactions and UTXOs in one place — the marketplace hub's own window onto the chain.

explorers.name: kcc20.info
explorers.shows: Public JSON for tokens, holders, balances, covenant events and signing data — no API key, local-first, validated from a Kaspa node.
explorers.note: in daily use — the site’s mainnet numbers come from its API
